title: Optimal GHZ-State Distribution in LOSR Quantum Networks via Local Decoding from Information Sets
summary: Distributing multipartite entanglement is a prerequisite for scalable quantum networks. Networks restricted to local operations and shared randomness (LOSR) avoid the quantum-memory and latency costs associated with the real-time classical communication required by LOCC-based networks. However, when only bipartite sources are available, LOSR networks cannot prepare useful GHZ states. In earlier work, we conjectured that multipartite sources overcome this limitation and supported this claim with a single numerical example. In this work, we prove the conjecture for regular and uniform networks…
